text: Published 12 October 2026. On 14 September 2026, the Republic of Ostmark signed a framework agreement with Brightwater Munitions for 155mm artillery shells. On 2 October 2026, the Ostmark procurement agency cancelled the agreement after a dispute over delivery schedules, an agency statement said. Brightwater Munitions plans to build a new filling plant in 2028 regardless of the cancellation, its chief executive told reporters. Officials did not say whether a new tender would be launched. The company is not affiliated with any state-owned group.
